description: This file implements utilities for Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA) and Exponential Moving Average (EMA) in PyTorch, including classes and functions for updating model parameters, batch normalization statistics, and learning rate scheduling.

classes.name: AveragedModel
classes.description: A PyTorch module that maintains an exponential moving average (EMA) or SWA of another model's parameters, supporting custom averaging functions and buffer updates.

classes.name: SWALR
classes.description: A learning rate scheduler designed for use with SWA, interpolating learning rates over a specified number of epochs.

methods.name: get_ema_multi_avg_fn
methods.description: Returns a function that applies exponential moving average (EMA) across multiple parameters.

methods.name: get_swa_multi_avg_fn
methods.description: Returns a function that applies stochastic weight averaging (SWA) across multiple parameters.

methods.name: get_ema_avg_fn
methods.description: Returns a function that applies EMA to a single parameter.

methods.name: get_swa_avg_fn
methods.description: Returns a function that applies SWA to a single parameter.

methods.name: update_bn
methods.description: Updates BatchNorm running statistics by passing data through the model.
